title: Open-air faith surpasses costly piety
english: Open-air faith is better than costly piety, and three gathered in the name of the Lord are better than many who deny the divinity (Matthew 18:20).

added_allusions.reason: three gathered in the Lord’s name

translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: The author continues his maxims by contrasting simple, open-air faith with expensive piety and three gathered in the Lord's name with many who deny the divinity.

title: Pure speech and a perfected soul as what is magnificent to God; piety as the only abiding good
english: Nothing is so magnificent to God as pure speech and a soul perfected by the teachings of truth.
Piety alone is an unchangeable and abiding good.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: The speaker continues the collection of maxims, now stating what is most magnificent to God and what alone is an unchangeable good.

title: Envy makes the unattainable unbelievable
english: For what is unattainable is somehow not believed because of envy; to profane souls, nothing among good things is believable.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: The author is closing the collection of maxims with a final warning about why profane souls reject good things.
